steps.subject: sky
steps.action: paint the sky with phthalo blue and white
steps.load: blue and white mixed on the brush
steps.motion: bounce color in across the sky
steps.rule: less pressure lets the black gesso show for a darker sky

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: tap white clouds with the top corner
steps.rule: tapping is the easiest way to make fluffy clouds

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: fluff clouds with a clean brush
steps.rule: a very light touch keeps the clouds soft

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: big dark storm clouds
steps.load: black, blue and crimson mixed on the brush
steps.rule: dark clouds push the light clouds back

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: stir and blend the dark clouds
steps.motion: stir gently with the top corner
steps.rule: keeps some light showing through

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blend the whole sky lightly

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tap small far-off tree shapes
steps.rule: far away, so no detail is needed

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tap bluer trees farther back

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: tap a small foothill
steps.motion: pull down at the bottom, lift at the top
steps.rule: light bottom and lifted top suggest distance

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tiny bluish far trees
steps.load: bluer version of the same mix
steps.rule: snow added later will make them show

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: brown trunks on the back trees
steps.new: some trunks poke above the tops

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: dark evergreens in the back
steps.load: full load of the dark mix
steps.motion: start at the corner, press harder toward the base
steps.rule: a few evergreens are enough for the back

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: add a second evergreen beside the first
steps.motion: tap in a big tree beside the first
steps.rule: keeps the first tree from being lonely

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: snow-covered branches with thin white and blue
steps.load: fan brush dipped in liquid clear
steps.rule: clear changes how the paint sits on the canvas

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: darken the base of the evergreen

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: lighter background tree with clear
steps.rule: the background tree should not grab attention

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: white snow under the tree
steps.load: heavy white loaded to a chisel edge
steps.motion: pull straight across under the tree
steps.rule: clear lets the white slide smoothly

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint light and dark sides of trunks in one stroke
steps.load: thin brown on one side, thin white on the other
steps.motion: pull through both colors at once
steps.rule: one stroke gives a light side and a dark side

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add a few limbs to the tree

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: scrape out a basic cabin shape
steps.rule: scraping is one of the easiest ways to make a shape

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: fill the cabin with brown
steps.rule: just blocking in color, no detail yet

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: warm the front of the cabin with white
steps.load: white with a little brown and crimson
steps.motion: barely touch with a roll of paint

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: dark boards and a door
steps.motion: touch in boards and a door

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: pile white snow on the roof
steps.rule: rough snow looks heavily piled on the old roof

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: outline two windows
steps.load: light gray on the small knife

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: snow around the cabin base

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: touch blue shadows into the snow
steps.rule: a cool shadow effect in the snow

steps.subject: fence
steps.action: fence rails with thin brown

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: snow on the fence top and around the base
steps.motion: dab snow along the top and base
steps.where: top of fence and cabin base
steps.rule: snow rests on top of the fence

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: tap bushes and weeds at the tree base
steps.motion: tap in a few little things

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: tap a small baby tree and twigs

steps.subject: land
steps.action: sideward pull through brown and white at the base

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: limbs in the upper trees with thin brown

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: dab snow under the tree and along the fence
steps.rule: picking up dark color makes little shadows

steps.subject: fence
steps.action: highlight the top of the fence and snow under it
steps.motion: a light touch across the top
